features:
Features:
+ NoWaterDamage | It removes water damage. You can walk on water.
+ NoDonateButtons | It disables donate buttons. You can walk on donate buttons without getting donate thing.
+ NoPay2WinGUIs | It hides Pay to Win GUIs. If you're on mobile, It's life saver.
+ noGUIs | It hides some other GUIs. No present button, No top bar GUI, No favorite it Roblox Core UI.
+ Autofarm (Teleport Farm, DOS Farm). | It gets wins for you. It also outputs some stats about wins.
+ UFAF | Useful features for autofarm. Static camera, No win GUIs, No win sound, No render.
+ NoMap | You can delete the map (locally). Op for 24/7 farming.
+ PrizeSpam | You can get as many prizes as you want.
+ Autopet | It buys pets for you.
+ PetX | It combines pets automatically.
+ DeviceBurner | It spams pets to lag other players devices.
+ AntiDeviceBurner | It protects your device from lags.
+ Teleport | You can teleport to different locations on the map.
+ SafeArea | Your safe spot.
+ Basic+ | Basic script functions.
+ RemoteItem | You can buy items remotely.
+ VelocityChanger | You can set any velocity. Velocity is like money in this game.
+ ItemFlaud | Flaud the spawn with ttems. It may help other players.
+ GoodScript | Inf Yield, Fates Admin, Ocra.
+ DisplayX | it display information about this script.
+ WebHook | It sends you information about the game.
+ NoGamePass | It removes all gamepasses from the game for everyone. Anti Pay to win stuff.
+ DeathRing | Pets can kill players. Really fun.
+ BecomeScott | You need a #ffffff white skin. Scott with pets is really fun.

Some information:
DOS Farm is the best farm.
Probably better than gift farm.

You need to wait to unlock other wins mode.

Extra:
#1 in wins leaderboard guaranteed.

#1 in jump leaderboard guaranteed.

#1 in time leaderboard not developed yet.
